premises.scope: invertible ORIGINAL-coordinate physical Schur elimination loses at most pivot dimension in threshold count, with no threshold-scale loss
M(h)=integral esssup_u h(u,z) dz controls U+psi(Z) for arbitrary measurable psi without independence

results.statement: If Q=a(X+m(Y))^2+R(Y), X is an original cap-one coordinate, and ||p_R||inf<=M, then ||p_Q||inf<=2sqrt(M/|a|).
For |a_j|>=tau_j L and terminal cap B/L, B0<=4^(1-2^-k) B^(2^-k) product_j tau_j^(-2^-j). In particular pivots >=(4/B)L preserve the same terminal constant B/L through arbitrary chain length.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: M(h)<=B/L implies terminal ||p_(U+psi(Z))||inf<=B/L; composing with the new pivot chain yields the same B/L if all preceding physical pivots satisfy |a_j|>=(4/B)L. For the partner's B=4pi example, threshold=1/pi and the final cap remains 4pi.

unresolved_implication: Extract a grouped-bank or weighted-volume terminal certificate in the dense mixed-sign residual class after certificate-adapted peeling, especially when every physical diagonal is below about 0.1888 L at the present collective-tail constant and local minors are tiny.
next_mechanism: Use the grouped-bank/weighted-volume rather than another one-coordinate pivot; preserve product provenance before inverse curvature costs.
